scope: Kaleidoscope: two manual rewards, each one default-odds reward from three distinct shuffled other unlocked character pools; factory and manual-group modifier boundaries; serialized source RNG.

runtime_validation_boundary: The installed build UI/task continuation after the modeled source exception needs Windows observation; no successful continuation or terminal loss is invented.
